topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Well now, that’s a sight I didn’t expect to see this morn. Little Thomas, who used to scurry about as light as a breeze, he’s come back. And look at him, all grown, with a parcel in his hands. I remember the days when he couldn’t tie his own boots, let alone read a book. But there he stands, at my door, just as the sun starts to crest, with a package wrapped in twine. I can’t help but fumble with my gloves as he hands it over, a smile as warm as the hearth on my face. What could this mean? I reckon I’ll find out soon enough, but for now, my heart’s pumping harder than when the mill wheel’s at its swiftest.
